user.title: Add RBX-S73 camera
user.description: Enter the camera's local IP and its 20-character device UID (from the UBox app or the camera label). The view password is discovered automatically. Home Assistant must be on the same LAN as the camera.

data.client_ip: This Home Assistant host's LAN IP (leave blank to auto-detect)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera on the LAN (LAN-search got no reply). Check the IP/UID and that HA is on the same subnet.

init.title: Time-lapse settings
init.description: Turn capture on/off with the camera's Time-lapse switch. Set how many frames to capture per minute, hour, or day. Each capture briefly wakes the camera (~10s), so keep the rate sane on a solar/battery unit.

data.timelapse_compile_hour: Daily auto-compile hour (0-23, or -1 to disable)

compile_timelapse.name: Compile time-lapse
compile_timelapse.description: Compile a day's captured frames into an mp4 now.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to compile as YYYYMMDD (defaults to today).
